output.title: Two-factor authentication setup
output.content: Enable two-factor authentication from Account Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy) and enter the 6-digit code to confirm setup. Save the backup codes shown at the end in a safe place.

output.title: Account locked — too many failed login attempts
output.content: If your account is locked after several incorrect password attempts, wait 30 minutes and try again, or use the 'Forgot password' link on the login page to reset your password immediately via an emailed link. This is fully self-service — no need to contact support.

output.title: Account locked — suspicious activity flag
output.content: If your account was locked due to a suspicious-activity flag (unusual location, new device, or an admin-triggered security hold), it cannot be unlocked by resetting your password. You must contact support directly so an agent can verify your identity manually before restoring access.

output.title: Adding and removing team members
output.content: Admins can add or remove team members from Account Settings > Team. Removing a member immediately revokes their access; there is no confirmation delay. Each member's role (Admin, Editor, Viewer) can be changed from the same screen.

output.title: API rate limits
output.content: The API allows 100 requests per minute on the Free and Pro plans, and 1000 requests per minute on the Enterprise plan. Exceeding the limit returns an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header.

steps.rawOutput:
Based on my search of the knowledge base, I was unable to find any documentation about SAML or SSO support. Here's my response to the customer:

---

**Subject: Re: SSO/SAML support for our team**

Thank you for reaching out, and I appreciate you sharing your security requirements upfront.

I searched our knowledge base and was unable to find documentation confirming SAML-based SSO support in our platform at this time. This is an important capability for enterprise teams, especially one your size.

I'd like to escalate this to our product team to get you a clear answer on:
1. Whether SAML/SSO support is currently available
2. If not, what the timeline or priority is for adding it to our roadmap

Given that this is a blocker for your team plan upgrade decision, I want to make sure you get an accurate and timely response. Could you provide:
- Any other specific SSO providers your team prefers (Okta, Azure AD, etc.)?
- A preferred timeline for when you'd need this capability in place?

I'll follow up with you directly as soon as I hear back from our product team. In the meantime, if you have other questions about the team plan or our security features, I'm happy to help.

---

This approach acknowledges the gap in documentation, escalates appropriately given the high-priority business impact, and sets realistic expectations rather than guessing at capabilities or timelines.
